stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: OpenAI is introducing an 'Intelligent UI' update to ChatGPT.
The feature allows the chatbot to generate interactive visuals like charts, diagrams, and buttons alongside text responses.
This update is rolling out to all users concurrently with the anticipated GPT-6 release.

stories.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Microsoft is significantly enhancing Copilot's capabilities within Windows.
The upgrade grants Copilot access to local files on the user's PC.
This integration is part of Microsoft's 'Hybrid Intelligence' strategy, allowing AI to take actions across the OS.

stories.title: Mistral says "Le Chonk" can challenge the best AI models
stories.author: Joel Khalili, wired.com
bullet_points: Mistral AI claims its model, 'Le Chonk,' can compete with leading proprietary AI models.
The key differentiator is that Le Chonk maintains an open-weight architecture.
This development signals a significant push in the open-source AI space against closed-source giants.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational tasks.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in generative AI tasks.
The model is categorized under key AI/ML tags including 'transformers' and 'llama'.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function.
The associated tags (transformers, llama, safetensors) confirm its status as a significant open-source LLM artifact.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local hardware execution, supporting multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a substantial developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon through updates to its MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and reduced memory usage for running models.
The updated engine also contributes to higher quality output from the language models.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows, indicating advanced AI application focus.

stories.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google has globally released an enhanced version of its SynthID AI content detector.
The updated tool is capable of identifying AI-generated content from multiple sources, including OpenAI.
This development is significant in the ongoing effort to combat misinformation and synthetic media.

stories.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Introduces IdeaAnchor, a new paradigm for training Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform research ideation.
Addresses the challenge of literature-grounded ideation, which currently lacks structured supervision in existing LLM approaches.
Utilizes structured specifications as privileged signals to guide LLMs in synthesizing ideas from scientific literature to identify research gaps.

stories.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
stories.author: Vladimir Petrik
bullet_points: DepthWorld introduces a 3D world model to address limitations in current video-based world models for robotics.
Current RGB-only models fail to maintain consistent 3D geometry across sequential rollouts, despite looking correct frame-by-frame.
The research highlights the need for large-scale 3D supervision and improved architectural design to advance robot manipulation using world models.

stories.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
stories.author: Seong Joon Oh
bullet_points: Introduces the concept of 'bottling,' where LLM agents convert general capabilities into cheap, task-specific artifacts.
Addresses the high cost of querying LLMs repeatedly for large, related workloads.
Presents BOTTLED, a new benchmark designed to test agents' ability to complete entire unlabelled workloads efficiently.

stories.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
stories.author: Nils Lukas
bullet_points: The research addresses a critical security vulnerability where malicious prompts on web pages can hijack autonomous web agents.
Current defenses are insufficient because attackers can adapt to models trained against static injection attacks.
The proposed solution involves adversarial training to create robust agents capable of handling adaptive prompt injection in dynamic web environments.

stories.title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
stories.author: Anirudha Majumdar
bullet_points: Introduces EgoLAP, a new VLA pre-training framework designed to bridge the embodiment gap in robotics.
Addresses the challenge of using raw, embodiment-specific human egocentric data for robot control by focusing on transferable motion intent.
Aims to scale robot learning beyond expensive physical demonstrations by leveraging language and human data.

stories.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
stories.author: Nils Lukas
bullet_points: The research addresses the vulnerability of web agents to adaptive prompt injection attacks from third-party content.
Current defenses are insufficient because attackers can adapt to models trained against fixed injection patterns.
The proposed solution involves adversarial training to build robust web agents capable of handling dynamic, malicious inputs.

stories.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Introduces IdeaAnchor, a new paradigm for training Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate scientific research ideas.
Addresses the challenge of literature-grounded ideation, which is difficult with current prompting or feedback methods.
Utilizes structured specifications as privileged signals to guide LLMs in synthesizing information from related papers to identify research gaps.

stories.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
stories.author: Nils Lukas
bullet_points: The research addresses the critical security vulnerability of prompt injection in web agents, where malicious instructions on third-party pages can hijack agent behavior.
Existing defenses are insufficient because attackers can adapt their injections to bypass models trained against static threats.
The proposed solution utilizes adversarial training to create robust web agents capable of handling adaptive and evolving prompt injection attacks in a web environment.

stories.title: OpenAI Launches Interactive Learning Visuals in ChatGPT for Hands-On Answers
stories.author: alifar
bullet_points: OpenAI has integrated interactive learning visuals into ChatGPT.
The new feature allows users to engage with hands-on modules for learning.
This represents an expansion of ChatGPT's utility beyond simple Q&A into active education.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of decision-making logic.
Decision models can process text to provide probabilistic answers for yes/no questions, choices, or scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 introduces performance enhancements and broader GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to expand model support across diverse hardware.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine, improving capabilities on Apple silicon.

stories.title: The first Nvidia RTX Spark laptops cost up to $7,000
stories.author: Antonio G. Di Benedetto
bullet_points: Nvidia has released the first laptops featuring its new RTX Spark chip.
These high-end laptops are positioned to compete directly with premium devices like the MacBook Pro.
Pricing starts relatively high, with flagship models reaching up to $7,000.

stories.title: Everything announced at Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra event
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Microsoft unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra during a recent keynote.
The new laptop features an Nvidia RTX Spark Arm-based chip.
The starting price for the Surface Laptop Ultra is set at $2,599.

stories.title: Fraudster jailed for using 10K bots and AI songs to outstream Taylor Swift
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A fraudster was jailed for an $8 million music streaming royalty scheme.
The scheme involved using automated '10K bots' and AI-generated songs.
The case highlights the emerging legal and ethical challenges surrounding AI-generated content in the music industry.

stories.title: Trade group crunches numbers on Trump’s impossible push for 100% US-made tech
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A trade group estimates that Trump's push for 100% US-made technology could result in significant financial costs for tech firms.
The potential cost associated with the aggressive reshoring push is quantified at $230 billion by the CTA.
The article analyzes the economic implications of potential future trade policies regarding domestic manufacturing in the tech sector.

stories.title: AI/ML is becoming a performance factor in motorsport
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: AI/ML is moving beyond simple sponsorship to become a functional performance factor in motorsport.
OpenAI is actively involved in assisting Ganassi with optimizing race car setups.
This signals a growing integration of advanced AI into high-stakes, real-world engineering applications.

stories.title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
stories.author: Cheng Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces 4D-HOF, a new feed-forward framework for reconstructing 4D hand-object interactions.
Addresses limitations of prior methods, specifically the high cost of per-sequence optimization and instability in generative approaches.
Leverages vision foundation models to provide coarse estimates, which are then refined using a conditional flow matching model.

stories.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
stories.author: Diyi Yang
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap in LLM capabilities: moving from problem-solving to effective teaching.
Current LLM teaching methods rely on fixed signals (demonstrations, preference data) rather than individual student outcomes.
The proposed 'Sherpa' aims to enable LLMs to teach adaptively based on real-time learner performance.

stories.title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
stories.author: Wenhao Ding
bullet_points: VeriFine addresses the limitation of fixed judges in self-improving AI systems, especially in embodied reasoning.
The framework scales verification capabilities to handle the evolving failure patterns of continuously learning agents.
It is crucial for embodied AI as it accounts for complex requirements like spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety.

stories.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
stories.author: Qifeng Chen
bullet_points: WorldSonus addresses the gap of silence in advanced visual world models.
The project tackles three core challenges: real-time audio generation, interactive sound control, and spatial audio alignment.
It introduces an interactive video-to-audio framework to enhance immersive synthetic environments.

stories.title: Denoising Hierarchical Representations: Joint Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
stories.author: Nikos Komodakis
bullet_points: Introduces Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (H-CDLMs) to advance Diffusion Language Models (DLMs).
H-CDLMs aim to improve continuous DLMs while maintaining minimal computational and parameter overhead.
The research builds upon recent advancements in continuous diffusion and flow matching models for text generation.

stories.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
stories.author: Diyi Yang
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap in LLM capabilities: moving beyond problem-solving to effective teaching.
Current LLM teaching methods rely on external signals (demonstrations, preference data) rather than individual student outcomes.
The proposed 'Sherpa' aims to enable LLMs to teach adaptively based on how individual students learn.

stories.title: The Missing Minimal Pair: Stereotype Evaluation in LLMs
stories.author: Björn Ross
bullet_points: The paper critiques the standard method of bias measurement in LLMs, which relies on single-pair log-likelihood comparisons.
It argues that single-pair comparisons are unreliable because simple rewrites can lead to logically inconsistent preferences.
The authors propose a 'dual minimal pair' setup and a data-augmentation framework for more robust stereotype evaluation in LLMs.

stories.title: Denoising Hierarchical Representations: Joint Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
stories.author: Nikos Komodakis
bullet_points: Introduces Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (H-CDLMs) to enhance existing Diffusion Language Models (DLMs).
H-CDLMs aim to improve continuous DLMs with minimal computational and parameter overhead.
The research builds upon recent advancements in continuous diffusion and flow matching for text generation.

stories.title: A Systematic Study of Semantic ID Spaces for Generative Information Retrieval
stories.author: Sylvain Lamprier
bullet_points: The paper addresses Generative Information Retrieval (GIR), a paradigm shift from traditional retrieval to sequence-to-sequence generation of document identifiers (DocIDs).
It highlights that the semantic design of DocIDs is crucial for GIR performance, but the underlying principles of what constitutes a 'good' DocID are not well-explored.
Current evaluation methods are noted as being computationally expensive, suggesting a need for more fundamental or efficient design criteria.

stories.title: When Forgetting is not Catastrophic: On the Mechanics of Spurious Forgetting
stories.author: Bernhard Schölkopf
bullet_points: The paper investigates 'spurious forgetting' in language models during finetuning, where seemingly lost knowledge can be recovered.
It describes a dynamic where forgetting caused by new training can temporarily reverse itself before permanent erosion occurs.
The researchers propose a minimal associative memory model that reproduces these complex forgetting and recovery dynamics.

stories.title: What Agent Builders Can Borrow from OpenAI's Math Research
stories.author: p0rt
bullet_points: The article explores how concepts from OpenAI's mathematical research can be applied to agent building.
It references specific examples, such as Lean proofs and a 'Symptomato' experiment.
The core topic involves developing independently verifiable rules for updating memory within AI agents.
